extension/src/store.test.ts.reason: The real Stop hook must renew retention for useful snapshot stores without changing workspace files.

extension/src/temproot.test.ts.reason: Git-discovered Vitest configurations must install the per-run temporary-directory setup.

extension/src/timeline-renderer.browser..reason: Production timeline rendering must preserve native disclosure, selection, navigation, and accessible interaction. Markdown preview links must deliver click and keyboard destinations while fenced source remains copyable. Explicit link actions must retain destination identity, native event context, and invoking-panel ownership. A pinned popover's View more expander must keep its Tab stop.

extension/src/timelinecheck.test.ts.reason: Npm and extension-directory invocations must inspect the caller project through the real command environment.

extension/src/usagerecord.test.ts.reason: Independent host processes must serialize near-cap usage writes while different day slots remain independent.

extension/src/web-demo-publish.test.ts.reason: The publish script must commit the built site through real Git processes on fixture repositories. It must leave the checkout unchanged and refuse unsafe source and branch states.

extension/src/web-demo.browser.test.ts.reason: The packaged static demo must preserve production menu, comment, navigation, and download interactions.

extension/src/webview.integration.browse.reason: Host publications must update the mounted production panel while preserving browser interaction and bounded rendering. A returning zoomed panel must become visible despite device-pixel rounding.

extension/src/webview/attachments.browse.reason: File attachments must preserve native paste, drop, focus, and prompt submission behavior.

extension/src/webview/clock.browser.test.reason: Rendered ages and cache states must update through the browser clock without losing panel state.

extension/src/webview/composer.browser.t.reason: Prompt controls must preserve permissions, saved defaults, completion, history, delayed replies, keyboard access, and focus. The Remote Control item must open its link popover by press and drop its words only when the row would wrap. A returned send must keep its notice through a session switch and newer typing.

extension/src/webview/queue-live.browser.reason: Queued and live prompts must preserve mounted browser input, focus, and submission actions.

extension/src/webview/search.browser.tes.reason: Search must preserve native text input, keyboard navigation, selection, and session opening.

extension/src/windowpipe.test.ts.reason: The native Windows pipe helper must preserve pending I/O, disconnect recovery, deadlines, and child-exit evidence.

plugins/arc-hooks/scripts/integration.te.reason: Real hook processes must preserve snapshot writes and metadata through the shell environment.

plugins/arc-hooks/scripts/lib.test.js.reason: Snapshot helpers must preserve Git and filesystem ownership across real command boundaries.

scripts/agent-review-evals.test.js.reason: Review commands must validate real repositories, exports, sandbox receipts, and executable status boundaries.

scripts/check-web-demo-site.test.js.reason: The site checker executable must reject invalid generated demo output.

scripts/commit-topic.test.js.reason: The source commit command must refuse main, detached and mismatched branches while preserving commit arguments, hooks, and topic delivery.

scripts/editor-cli.test.js.reason: Editor launch and installer shell commands must preserve quoting, cancellation, native entry selection, existing dependencies, lockfile reconciliation, and component outcomes. Default installation must preserve personal skills and global hook configuration. Explicit selectors must retain cancellation and conflict behavior. Commit installs must select frozen source and preserve the checkout and index.

scripts/extension-test-runner.test.js.reason: Real runner commands must classify files, reject invalid selection, and preserve browser readiness status.

scripts/install-release.test.js.reason: Release installation must extract actual archives and preserve isolated-home hooks, skills, and partial failures.

scripts/isolated-editor.test.js.reason: The isolated editor launcher must retain owned process receipts and reject cleanup or launch failures, and refuse a staged Windows VS Code update before it launches.

scripts/register-hooks.test.js.reason: The registration executable must preserve existing user settings and install the selected hook configuration.

scripts/source-identity.test.js.reason: Real Git source identity must agree with build inputs and reject inconsistent repository metadata.

scripts/test-installer.test.js.reason: Printed checkout launchers must preserve active external Claude sessions, terminal receipts, detached descendants, and PID reuse alongside installer identity and alias boundaries.

scripts/test-lanes.test.js.reason: Public commands must report independent failures, preserve cancellation, and reject stale or incomplete landing evidence. Direct cases guard category and admission drift. Machine load cases admit lanes by load class, serialize each heavy lane in arrival order, wait for per-lane free memory, and cap Vitest workers.

scripts/tool-scope.test.js.reason: Real tool commands must respect repository scope and reject external configuration or stale packaged content.

scripts/typecheck-parallel.test.js.reason: Concurrent check child processes must preserve exit status, spawn errors, and grouped output.

test/hooks-smoke.test.js.reason: The installed hook command must capture real first-touch snapshots through the shell entry point.
